coverage_notes: All seven supplied observations and six CSV records considered. Registered Table 4 on PDF p.6 and material/method context on pp.1-2 visually inspected. Registry and CSV unchanged.
shared_qualifications: C1: Nominal atomic/molar coefficients are converted only for chemistry comparison: wt.%_i = 100*n_i*M_i / sum(n_j*M_j), over the complete stated formula. CIAAW abridged standard atomic weights 2024: Al 26.982, Co 58.933, Cr 51.996, Fe 55.845, Ni 58.693, Si 28.085, B 10.81 (https://ciaaw.org/abridged-atomic-weights.htm). Calculated nominal wt.% is not a measured analysis.
Table 4 calls these Epit values; p.293 also discusses intercrystalline, crevice and selective corrosion. The physical qualification does not exclude the registered outcomes.

obs_006/obs_007: Table 4 assigns 0.14 V to 800 C and 0.18 V to 950 C. CRA 591 (800 C) contains 180 mV and CRA 590 (950 C) contains 140 mV. Supported links follow the independently specified aging temperatures; targets appear transposed.

observations.notes: Table 4 304L comparator (0.48 V) has no counterpart: all six CRA records describe the Al0.5CoCrFeNi alloy.
